mobbin:024a7f32-0ecc-4767-9123-0fb0830f2.summary: Host opens Scan to Check In, confirms a scanned guest on a sheet, then gets a green success toast while the scanner stays ready for the next person.
steps: Scan to Check In — viewfinder + List/Scan toggle
Guest sheet — name, status Going, Check In
Green toast — Guest checked in (scan stays open)
steal: Confirm-before-commit guest sheet with name/email/status before Check In (step 2) — prevents wrong roster tags.
Inline green success pill without leaving the scanner (step 3) — keeps throughput for a line of learners.
List ↔ Scan segmented control + search shortcut (step 1) — QR fail path without abandoning the flow.
Flashlight control on the scan chrome (step 1) — real rooms are poorly lit.
avoid: Tagging this as equipment-check — screens only show guest ticket check-in, not room/device setup.
mobbin:024a7f32-0ecc-4767-9123-0fb0830f2.fit: Mobile beats desktop for door-side learner tagging: QR scan + one-tap confirm replaces paper roster / SRV search; same pattern maps to room QR for equipment-check but this flow itself is people only.

mobbin:26b0f3ea-2156-43d2-b580-f4774fbb7.summary: From an event card the host opens Check In, scans a guest, confirms identity, then can Undo Check In after success.
steps: Event card — Invite / Check In / Blast / More
Camera scan — viewfinder + list + flip camera
Guest sheet — Jason Smith, Check In
Success — Check In Successful + Undo Check In
steal: Check In as a first-class action on the session/event card (step 1) — not buried in settings.
Confirm sheet before commit (step 3) — name + status Going + ticket type.
Undo Check In on the success sheet (step 4) — fast recovery from accidental scan.
Flip-camera control on the scanner (step 2) — front/rear for badge vs phone-held QR.
mobbin:26b0f3ea-2156-43d2-b580-f4774fbb7.fit: Phone-in-hand at the room door beats TouchPro-only tagging; extends Baseline learner tagging / QR checklist with undo and confirm.
